rows.notes: The paper is conceptual: the Methodology states it was based on case studies and conceptual methods, summarising problems from historical information and proposing a mobile weather-forecasting app with a conceptual flowchart. No own data, survey, experiment or model runs are reported; the benefits of the app (protecting crops, saving irrigation water and energy) are asserted, not measured. The authors themselves recommend a pilot project to test feasibility. It therefore provides no primary evidence that weather-forecasting apps or DSSs mitigate weather/climate impacts on farms.

notes: Full text appears complete (pp. 53-61). Study is a conceptual/extension-style article without primary data.
